description: This PHP script generates a requirements overview page with an ExtJS table, listing requirements and their details, including custom fields, relations, and coverage data, for a specific test project in the TestLink open source test management tool.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class used to generate and manage the ExtJS table for displaying requirements.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes user input parameters for the page, such as selected test project and version options.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI data structure including page title, warning messages, and project name.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings such as character set, date formats, and GUI labels.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions to access the requirements overview page.
